english: $$f(t)=\begin{cases}t^{2}, & -3\le t<0,\\ 3t+10, & 0\le t\le5,\end{cases}\qquad g(x)=\begin{cases}x-1, & x<0,\\ x^{2}+2, & x\ge0.\end{cases}$$

Let $D$ be the set of all real numbers $x$ for which $(f\circ g)(x)$ is defined, and let $R$ be the set of all values of $(f\circ g)(x)$ for $x\in D$. Then the sum of all the integers in $R$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $f:[-3,5]\to\mathbb{R}$ तथा $g:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ निम्न द्वारा परिभाषित हैं
$$f(t)=\begin{cases}t^{2}, & -3\le t<0,\\ 3t+10, & 0\le t\le5,\end{cases}\qquad g(x)=\begin{cases}x-1, & x<0,\\ x^{2}+2, & x\ge0.\end{cases}$$

माना कि $D$ उन सभी वास्तविक संख्याओं $x$ का समुच्चय है जिनके लिए $(f\circ g)(x)$ परिभाषित है, तथा $R$, $x\in D$ के लिए $(f\circ g)(x)$ के सभी मानों का समुच्चय है। तब $R$ में स्थित सभी पूर्णांकों का योगफल ______ है।
solution_full: $(f\circ g)(x)=f(g(x))$ is defined exactly when $g(x)$ lies in the domain $[-3,5]$ of $f$.
For $x<0$: $g(x)=x-1$, which is $<-1$. The condition $x-1\ge-3$ gives $x\ge-2$, so $x\in[-2,0)$, and as $x$ runs over $[-2,0)$, $t=g(x)$ runs over $[-3,-1)$.
For $x\ge0$: $g(x)=x^{2}+2\ge2$. The condition $x^{2}+2\le5$ gives $0\le x\le\sqrt3$, and $t=g(x)$ runs over $[2,5]$.
Hence $D=[-2,0)\cup[0,\sqrt3]=[-2,\sqrt3]$, and the values of $g$ on $D$ form $[-3,-1)\cup[2,5]$. The part $[-1,2)$ of the domain of $f$ is never reached.
For $t\in[-3,-1)$, $f(t)=t^{2}$ and $t^{2}$ decreases from $9$ (at $t=-3$) towards $1$ (not attained), so these values form $(1,9]$.
So $R=(1,9]\cup[16,25]$. Its integers are $2,3,\dots,9$, with sum $\dfrac{(2+9)\cdot8}{2}=44$, and $16,17,\dots,25$, with sum $\dfrac{(16+25)\cdot10}{2}=205$.
The required sum is $44+205=249$. (Taking the whole range of $f$, $(0,9]\cup[10,25]$, would wrongly give $325$.)
originality_note: New: composition of two piecewise functions in which the inner function skips a band [-1, 2) of the outer domain, so the range of the composite has a gap that the range of f alone does not have (way 5). Closest known: domain and formula of f(g(x)) for piecewise f, g. Different because: the answer depends on which values the inner function actually reaches, not just on the domain condition.

concept_use.Piecewise-defined functions: domain and: Range of each piece of f: t^2 on [-3,-1) gives (1,9] and 3t + 10 on [2,5] gives [16,25].
concept_use.Composite functions: domain and composit: f(g(x)) is defined iff g(x) lies in [-3,5], giving D = [-2, sqrt3]; the composition uses the pieces x - 1 (x < 0) and x^2 + 2 (x >= 0) of g.

key_step: Tracking which values the inner piecewise function actually takes, [-3,-1) and [2,5], before applying f.
justification: Composition of piecewise functions with a domain restriction and a gap in the inner range; one slip (using the whole range of f, or including 1) changes the answer; numerical. Comparable to 2024-P1-Q17 (L3).
